# Cavalli Club Dubai

> Cavalli Club is a restaurant, lounge and nightclub at Fairmont Dubai, the 394-room hotel on Sheikh Zayed Road opposite the Dubai World Trade Centre. Opened in 2009 and carrying the Roberto Cavalli fashion name, the venue became known for a crystal-clad interior spread over two levels, with a dining room, bar and dance floor. It operated as one of the city's higher-profile late-night venues.

## Project Overview

- Category: Hospitality & Landmark Entertainment
- Location: Trade Centre, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

Cavalli Club is a restaurant, lounge and nightclub at the Fairmont Dubai on Sheikh Zayed Road, opened in 2009 under the Roberto Cavalli fashion brand. MENASCO supplied and installed additional fan coil units (FCUs) for the venue, adding air-conditioning capacity to the club's existing HVAC system. The works were carried out for Dynamic Motions within a high-profile, operational hospitality venue.
